amendment_reason: v1 Prisma schema did not require status, but its UI/integration fixtures did

requirements: Write the Prisma models for Outpost and Dispatch, with correct one-to-many relation sides.
The Dispatch.outpostId foreign key is required; its relation field must have matching nullability.
Use String @id @default(cuid()) primary keys and an Int measurement field.
Declared delete semantics must match foreign-key optionality: SetNull if optional, Restrict if required.
The child model also stores status String @default("received"), persisted for UI/API workflows.
tasks.user_story: Manage Dispatch records linked to Outpost in the mountainrescue service.

requirements: Implement Next.js GET /api/mountainrescue-dispatchs using db.dispatch.findMany.
Use searchParams 'q' as a case-insensitive title substring filter only when supplied.
Filter by optional outpostId, order by title ascending, include outpost.
Return { dispatchs: [...], total: number } with status 200; empty results return [] and 0.
The listed records include the persisted status field.
tasks.user_story: Manage Dispatch records linked to Outpost in the mountainrescue service.

requirements: Implement POST /api/mountainrescue-dispatchs; trim required title and validate distanceKm as a finite integer.
Enforce 1 <= distanceKm <= 300 with HTTP 400 on missing/invalid/out-of-range values.
Check Outpost.id existence with findUnique; unknown parent returns HTTP 404, except null is allowed if FK optional.
Reject duplicate title within one Outpost with HTTP 409. Create only after every check and return 201.
Create status as 'received' unless a valid workflow transition changes it later.
tasks.user_story: Manage Dispatch records linked to Outpost in the mountainrescue service.

requirements: Implement canAdvanceDispatch(current, next): boolean for exact transitions received→mobilized and mobilized→resolved.
Every other transition is false, including unknown states, skips, reversals and unchanged states.
Use these exact domain-specific words; do not copy stage names from any illustrative demo.
tasks.user_story: Manage Dispatch records linked to Outpost in the mountainrescue service.

requirements: Build a responsive React component listing Dispatch items from a provided data prop; no network call required.
Provide a labeled search field, an accessible status filter and a clear-filters button.
Render title, distanceKm and current workflow status, with an explicit no-results empty state.
Keyboard operation and a 320px mobile viewport must remain usable without horizontal overflow.
tasks.user_story: Manage Dispatch records linked to Outpost in the mountainrescue service.

requirements: Connect a React create form to the GET/POST route and persisted Dispatch model in this domain.
After HTTP 201, update the visible list and total without a full-page reload.
Display 400/404/409 validation failures and preserve form data for correction.
A subsequent GET must return the persisted item; no fake local-only success is accepted.
The list displays the persisted status, not a fabricated client-only value.
tasks.user_story: Manage Dispatch records linked to Outpost in the mountainrescue service.
